messages:
rita: quick heads up: premerge DAST is blocking several frontend PRs with an "insecure-cors" finding after the middleware refactor. QA says CORS policy didn't change in prod, so likely scanner config or probe path changed.

omar: can you paste one of the failing lines?

rita: sample: `DAST: insecure-cors on /api/v1/login - Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` but our staging shows a specific origin header set.

chris: staging does set `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://staging.redwood.com`. maybe scanner follows an alternate path or hits an env var that flips to wildcard in test mode.

devops-bot: scheduling a repro run in staging cluster: run-DAST-20251109-03 queued.

omar: while that runs, can we mark DAST findings on auth endpoints as high-confidence? I don't want false negatives for CORS.

rita: agreed on high-confidence, but we need triage so teams aren't blocked by flaky probe paths. add a human triage step if the same endpoint alternates between pass/fail within 3 runs.

sec-bot: correlation: recent middleware refactor PR #519 updated default CORS to `*` in env test, intended for local dev only. commit by dev@redwood.com. audit ID AL-20251109-1455.

omar: there it is. accidental dev-mode flag leaked to the staging config. will revert and redeploy.

devops-bot: deploy revert initiated: infra#519-revert at 2025-11-09T04:12:00Z.

chris: followup: add a gated check that prevents merges which set CORS env to `*` for non-local clusters. simple preflight checker in pipeline. I'll open a PR.

rita: and add a DAST probe that includes a header `X-Redwood-Test: 1` so we can identify scanner requests vs real clients. reduces accidental env toggles in config.

omar: also put a note in the secure-sdlc checklist: "verify staging env flags not set to allowlist=*". small wins.

sec-bot: incident ticket created SEC-DAST-102. severity: medium (blocked merges). linked commit: infra#519.

rita: okay revert worked, staging DAST run queued, will update when green. thanks all.

chris: once reverted, let's run a full scan in a separate job so we don't block the premerge for unrelated PRs. configure DAST matrix with `allowlist_check=true`.

devops-bot: run-DAST-20251109-03 completed: 98% pass, 2% flaky endpoints re: rate-limit headers. no insecure-cors findings post-revert.

rita: closing: mitigated. will add follow-ups to security board: preflight env-check, DAST header, and triage rule for flaky endpoints.

sec-bot: SEC-DAST-102 resolved.
